description:
Validate the preloaded canonical Milestone 3 delivery plan against the exact baseline approved by M2-E37. The roadmap is `roadmap/milestones/03-add-durable-resume/milestone.md`. The Beadwork hierarchy already contains parent `jido_console-m3` and child epics `jido_console-m3e01` through `jido_console-m3e37`; do not import replacement records.

After M2-E37 closes, compare the approved Milestone 2 source, Jidoka revision, roadmap version, and production candidate with the preloaded plan. Correct any roadmap or Beadwork drift. Verify all 37 identifiers, parent-child relations, owners, priorities, effort labels, one-pull-request boundaries, and 110 direct blocker relations. Verify that the graph is acyclic and that M3-E01 is the only ready Milestone 3 implementation epic. Close this task only after that comparison passes.

This is planning and readiness work only. Do not implement durable storage or recovery. Plan source-quality milestones only. Do not create publication epics or tag, package, or release tasks. Keep candidate proof and the evidence-only quality audit as separate final epics.

Prerequisite: start only after M2-E37 approves one exact post-closeout Milestone 2 source and roadmap version as the Milestone 3 baseline. Do not use the historical M2-E33 or M2-E34 evidence as that baseline.
